verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes general SSO concept docs and SCIM/event-hook mechanics but contains no evidence about the size or breadth of Okta's app integration catalog, pre-built SAML/OIDC connectors, or claims about 'minutes not custom projects' setup speed.
